## 2. Technical Stack & Proficiencies

### Frontend Development
- **Core Technologies**: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 Semantic Elements, CSS3 / Modern CSS
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: React.js (v18 & v19), Next.js, Vite
- **UI & Styling**: Tailwind CSS (v4), Glassmorphism, Micro-interactions, Responsive Design (Mobile-First)
- **Animation & Graphics**: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), ScrollTrigger, Framer Motion / Motion One, Three.js, OGL (Lightweight WebGL library)
- **State Management & Data Fetching**: React Hooks, Context API, REST APIs, WebSocket client listeners

### Backend Development
- **Environments & Runtimes**: Node.js, Python 3
- **Frameworks**: Express.js, FastAPI
- **Real-Time Communication**: WebSockets, Socket.io, Server-Sent Events (SSE)
- **Authentication & Security**: JSON Web Tokens (JWT), bcrypt password hashing, CORS configuration, Cookie-based session security
- **API Architecture**: RESTful API design, input validation, structured error handling

### Databases & Storage
- **NoSQL**: MongoDB, Mongoose ODM
- **Relational Databases (SQL)**: PostgreSQL, MySQL
- **Caching**: Redis fundamentals

### Tools & Engineering Practices
- **Version Control**: Git, GitHub (branching, PRs, CI/CD integration)
- **Testing & Debugging**: Chrome DevTools, Postman, Node.js profiling
- **Deployment**: Vercel, Netlify, Render
- **Methodologies**: Component-driven architecture, Core Web Vitals optimization (LCP, INP, CLS), Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA standards)

## 3. In-Depth Project Case Studies

### Project 1: Real-Time Messaging Platform
- **Live Deployment**: https://real-time-chat-rosy-phi.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: Available on GitHub (https://github.com/SaptarshiCodes)
- **Problem Statement**: Standard HTTP REST APIs introduce polling latency when building messaging systems. Users need instant message delivery, live presence indicators, and encrypted authentication.
- **Architectural Solution**:
  - Engineered a bi-directional WebSocket connection layer using Socket.io and Node.js.
  - Implemented secure user authentication with stateless JSON Web Tokens (JWT) stored in HTTP-only cookies.
  - Designed MongoDB schemas with indexing on user pairs and timestamps to achieve sub-50ms message history retrieval.
  - Built an intuitive, reactive UI using React and Tailwind CSS with real-time typing notifications and message delivery acknowledgments.

### Project 2: Collaborative Coding Interview Platform
- **Live Deployment**: https://coding-platform-jet-two.vercel.app/
- **Problem Statement**: Remote technical interviews often suffer from disconnected workflows where candidates must juggle separate video calls, coding pads, and execution terminals.
- **Architectural Solution**:
  - Unified live video communications with synchronized code editing into a single performant web application.
  - Integrated Stream Video SDK for low-latency peer-to-peer audio and video transmission.
  - Implemented multi-language code editing with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, and sandboxed remote code execution.
  - Structured interviewer candidate evaluation scorecards and session sharing for collaborative hiring panels.

### Project 3: MPLADS Risk Monitor
- **Live Deployment**: https://mplad-risk-monitor.vercel.app/
- **Problem Statement**: The Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS) handles public funds across thousands of projects. Lack of centralized anomaly detection can lead to unmonitored delays and contractor concentration.
- **Architectural Solution**:
  - Developed an end-to-end analytics and governance monitoring dashboard.
  - Processed and visualized multi-district constituency fund utilization rates, milestone velocity, and contractor allocation percentages.
  - Implemented heuristic risk indicators flagging fund stagnation, cost overrun risks, and single-contractor monopolies.
  - Delivered responsive data visualizations and filterable data tables using React, Tailwind CSS, and Python FastAPI endpoints.
